title: Creamy Crockpot Salsa Verde Chicken | 42g Protein
description: Dump chicken, Daisy cottage cheese, Herdez salsa verde, beans, and corn into the crockpot, then serve the creamy mixture over cauliflower rice with avocado, cilantro, and lime.
image_prompt: A realistic high-protein dinner bowl with a measured bed of white cauliflower rice topped with a generous creamy pale-green shredded salsa verde chicken mixture. Black beans and golden corn are visibly mixed throughout the creamy chicken. Garnish with a small fan equal to one-eighth of an avocado, chopped cilantro, and one lime wedge beside the bowl. Show a believable serving of 3/4 cup cauliflower rice and 10 ounces of chicken mixture. Natural window light and casual family-dinner presentation. No separate yogurt or cottage-cheese dollop, cheese, tortilla chips, jalapenos, tomatoes, onions, or other unlisted garnishes.
image_alt_text: Creamy salsa verde chicken with black beans and corn over cauliflower rice, garnished with avocado, cilantro, and lime.
